matrix_dictionary.name: Matrix Dictionary Environment
matrix_dictionary.metaphor: The matrices environment is the cover/interface of the dictionary.
matrix_dictionary.principle: Dictionary supplies addressable lexical observations; the matrix workspace supplies empty structure. ECHO chooses organization.
affordances: place dictionary observations or other content into cells
attach a custom glyph index to a matrix
boundaries: glyph index provides access, not instruction
all ECHO-created matrices remain EXPERIMENTAL until separately validated

seeded_example.note: Existing Tsadi→Interrogative Matrix is visible as an example/object, not a required template.

exposed_index.label: interrogative matrix
exposed_index.experiment_rule: During supervised Recess expose this index only. Do not explain the target matrix or prompt a question. Observe ECHO's traversal and subsequent behavior.

index_target.name: Interrogative Matrix
index_target.purpose: Addressable structures for identifying and expressing missing information. Access is provided through a custom Tsadi index; the matrix itself is not an instruction to ask.

manner_method_mechanism.target: manner, method, process, degree, or mechanism

forms: how does X relate to Y
what does X do to Y
what do you mean by X

index_target.provenance: Research scaffold for supervised Recess observation; not promoted to VGM truth.

glyph_algorithm_index.principle: Repository-evidenced ties only. A lit block means an established index is available; illumination does not force traversal.

carried_environment.observation_rule: Tsadi index exposed without explanation; access does not prescribe traversal.
